_schema: One entry per sound_id that has a real recording dropped into this folder (see app/static/js/sounds.js for the authoritative id list — a sound with no entry here is still synthesised). Required fields per entry: display_name_ar, display_name_en (must match sounds.js exactly, so the attribution record and the in-game name never drift apart), source ('freesound' | 'opengameart' | the exact name of another source whose license was individually verified), creator (the uploader/recordist name exactly as credited at the source), license (the exact license, e.g. 'CC0 1.0', 'CC-BY 4.0' with the required attribution text if not CC0), source_url (the exact page the file was downloaded from — not a search results page), original_filename, file (the shipped filename in this folder), downloaded_at (ISO 8601 date), processing (what import_audio.py did: sample rate, trim, loudness target), reviewed_by_ear (true only after a human listened to the FINAL processed file and confirmed it is immediately recognizable and not a generic tone). An entry must never be added or left in place without every field filled in and reviewed_by_ear true — see tools/import_audio.py and this folder's README.md.
